title: 3D scene studio
subtitle: Choose a shot, place your objects and press Play.
speedHelp: Applies to playback and MP4 export.
gizmoHelp: Inside the scene, press G to move, R to rotate around Y, or S to scale. Drag the gizmo; use its centre to scale proportionally.
transformShortcuts: Inside the scene: R to rotate around Y · S to scale · G to move. Drag the gizmo to adjust the object.
keepAssets: Keep my objects when changing shots
cameraHelp: Camera changes are editable; your objects keep their identity.
